newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was active in the Panhandle area till midmorning Wednesday then at standstill at the close. Slaughter steers and heifers closed steady.

Feedlots reported moderate inquiry early, light late from buyers. Sales reported on 19,600 slaughter steers and 7,300 heifers; 97,600 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 60 loads or 2,000 head of CME cattle delivered to area packing plants, 15,600 formulated and 1,900 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Steers - select and choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 69.00. Pen select and choice 1-3 1300 lbs Holsteins 63.00.
Wk to date: 97,600 Week Ago: 103,200 Year Ago: 66,600
